title: Normalized Likelihood Criteria for Model Selection in the Stochastic Block Model
summary: Estimating the number of communities is a fundamental problem in network analysis under the stochastic block model (SBM). In this paper, we study penalized estimators for this task based on normalized likelihood criteria. We show that a penalized estimator derived from the Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) is strongly consistent with a logarithmic penalty term, although its computation is intractable.
